summary: This bill appropriates funds from the Treasury to ensure continued payments for the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) during any federal government shutdown.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly appropriates funds from the Treasury to ensure payments for the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) continue during a federal government shutdown. This represents an increase in government spending specifically to maintain a program during a lapse in appropriations.

The bill mandates automatic 'such sums as necessary' appropriations for LIHEAP during any lapse in discretionary funding, directly authorizing additional federal spending to continue the program without offsetting cuts or revenue, thereby accepting a larger deficit to protect this priority.
